title: ADPARAPHRASE V2.0: Generating Attractive Ad Texts Using a Preference-Annotated Paraphrase Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Addressed during the human annotation phase by randomizing the order of ad text options presented to crowdworkers to prevent ordering effects in preference judgments.

Evaluated by analyzing the correlation between text length (character/word counts) and human preference judgments using chi-square tests, noting that generative models (like DPO-based models) benefit from an evaluator bias where longer texts are perceived as more attractive.
